title: Snake Charmer Detective
description: A stylized black and white portrait of a man wearing a fedora and round patterned glasses, extending his hand toward a large blue-and-white patterned snake that coils around his arm and shoulder. The dark background is filled with white and blue floral illustrations, butterflies, birds, and circular icons containing various symbols and small figures.
prompt: A mysterious man in a fedora and round patterned glasses reaches his hand forward as a large ornate blue and white snake coils around his arm and body. Surreal black background covered in white and blue flowers, vines, butterflies, and small symbolic circular icons. High contrast chalk drawing style with selective blue coloring on the snake and flowers.
